how to run
I’ll check the project README and CLI entry points so the run instructions match this checkout.

From the repository root, install PhantomShell in a virtual environment and pull the model:

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
ollama pull gemma4:e4b
```

Then use two terminals, with the virtual environment activated in each:

```bash
# Terminal 1: start the dashboard
phantomshell serve
```

```bash
# Terminal 2: start an instrumented Bash
phantomshell run
```

The dashboard prints a local URL with a launch token. In the instrumented Bash, run commands as usual; captured events are saved in SQLite.

To capture just one command instead:

```bash
phantomshell run -- python build.py
```

To capture without model inference, add `--no-model` before `--`:

```bash
phantomshell run --no-model -- python build.py
```

For the demo fixture, go to `demo/fixture_project`, run `./reset.sh`, then `python build.py`. The project’s [README]([PROJECT_PATH]/E8BA8138BA810472/My%20Folders/Hacktoberfest/Phantom-Shell/README.md) has more details.

The core app is implemented, but the full plan isn’t complete or fully verified.

The terminal capture, SQLite storage, local Ollama calls, read-only investigation tools, evidence checks, approval dashboard, and memory logic are in place. The checks run during implementation passed.

Some planned end-to-end work remains unverified: the live model’s conclusion stayed inconclusive, so memory promotion across two sessions wasn’t demonstrated. Network-isolated operation and clean-clone setup also weren’t verified.
